text: The author pack works end to end: a project declaring `languages: [author]` loads `/in-author-essentials` on `/in-session` and `/in-review` dispatches only `critic-author` (not the code critics); `critic-author` runs the mechanical tier by default and recommends `/in-detrope` for full diagnosis under direct instruction.
